main_text.p: 1.Pet.s. 5. Th. ἡμεῖς ... vestite me orno. κοσμέω τος τὸ, vestitus elegans der geschmuck.
ἐγκόπτω interpello,impedio. F.ἐγκόψω.aor.1. ἐνέκοψα. P.act. ἐγκέκοφα. praes.pass. ἐγκόπτομαι impedior. imperf.pass. ἐνεκοπτόμην impediebar, Roman.15.22. P.med. ἐγκέκοπται. unde est.
ἐγκρατέομαι contineo me, sum continens, 1.Cor.7.9. F.ἐγκρατεύομαι. P.ἐγκεκρατεῦμαι.
ἐγκρατὴς ἐς ὁ ἡ continens, Tit.1.8. ex ἐν & κράτος ἐς τὸ robur. verè fortis est, qui se-ipsum potest continere.
ἐγκλείω admitto, adopto, allego, adjungo. F. ἐγκλείσω. P. ἐγκέκλεικα. aor.1. act. ἐνέκλεισα, aor.1. act.infin. ἐγκλεῖσαι adjungere, 2.Cor. 10.12.
ἐγκρύπτω condo,intego. F.ψω. P.ἐγκέκρυφα. a.1.act. ἐνέκρυψα, Matth.13.33.
ἔγκυος ἡ praegnans, gravida. ex ἐν & κύω gravida sum,in utero gesto, Luc.2.5.
ἐγχρίω inungo (ex ἐν & χρίω.) F.ἰσω. P.ἐγκέχρισμαι. aor.1. ἐνέχρισα. a.1. imperat. ἔγχρισον unge ἄπω junge, Apoc.3.18.
ἐγὼ Attice ἐγώ ego pronomen g.o.
ἑδαφος ἐς τὸ folum, pavimentum, Actor. 22.7. Them. ἑζῶ sedere facio, ἑζόμαι sedeo. F.ἑδέομαι.
Marginal fragments on the left strip are part of the facing page and are not transcribed.

page.notes: Greek and the marginal strip at left are partly illegible; several Greek accents and breathings are uncertain and may differ in the print. The left-hand strip is the edge of the facing page and was not transcribed beyond identification.
